answer_1.quote: We propose a novel summarization task that emphasizes supporting decision making.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics demonstrate that our method (DecSum) outperforms text-only summarization methods and model-based explanation methods in decision faithfulness and decision representativeness.

answer_4.quote: We use Mechanical Turk to conduct our human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: given a pair of restaurants with the same average rating of first 10 reviews, we ask participants to guess which will be rated better after 50 reviews
